# ZViewer

> ZViewer is an offline native Android comic reader for local archives (ZIP/CBZ, RAR/CBR, 7Z), PDF, image folders, and video folders, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

ZViewer (`dev.zolive.zviewer`) targets Android 10+ (minSdk 29, compile/target SDK 36) and ships a universal APK for `arm64-v8a` and `x86_64`. All content is processed on-device: the release manifest requests no network, external-storage, or all-files permissions, and uses a Storage Access Framework (SAF) persistent read grant for a user-selected library folder. The UI and Chinese docs are written in Simplified Chinese. Current version: 1.3.1 (`versionCode 9`). License: MIT.

## Features

- Comic sources: ZIP / CBZ, RAR / CBR, 7Z (via libarchive), PDF (via `PdfRenderer`), image folders, and video folders or video-only archives.
- Static images: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, HEIF, HEIC, AVIF.
- Animated images: APNG, animated WebP, GIF, animated AVIF (via APNG4Android + libavif).
- Library: recursive scan, natural filename sorting (`2.jpg` before `10.jpg`), HD covers, search, reading-status filter, recently read, favorites, 2–5 column grid.
- Reader: continuous vertical or paged horizontal images with adjacent loop boundaries; vertical/horizontal video switching; mixed image/video books use horizontal paging and show the seek slider only on video pages; a finished video replays from the start when revisited after auto-advancing; per-video positions, pinch and double-tap zoom, toolbar play/pause and seek slider, page/video-number jump, keep screen on. Mixed image/video reading is a WIP experimental feature: paging, switching, looping, autoplay, and background-resume interactions and their combinations may behave unexpectedly; pure image or pure video books are unaffected.
- Appearance: follow-system / light / dark theme, preset or custom accent color, independent light/dark reading backgrounds.
- Storage: manual cache clearing plus automatic reclamation at ~1.5 GiB.

## Supported Formats

| Kind | Extensions |
| --- | --- |
| Archives | `zip`, `cbz`, `rar`, `cbr`, `7z` |
| Documents | `pdf` |
| Static images | `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `webp`, `bmp`, `heif`, `heic`, `avif` |
| Animated images | `apng`, animated `webp`, `gif`, animated `avif` |
| Video | `mp4`, `m4v`, `mkv`, `webm`, `avi`, `mov`, `3gp`, `3g2`, `mpg`, `mpeg`, `ts`, `mts`, `m2ts`, `flv`, `wmv`, `ogv`, `vob`, `rm`, `rmvb` |

Not supported: encrypted or multi-volume archives, password-protected PDFs, DRM content, animated HEIF. Solid 7Z archives require preparing the whole book on first open.

## Architecture

- `app/src/main/java/dev/zolive/zviewer/MainActivity.kt` — single Activity, edge-to-edge Compose host.
- `LibraryViewModel.kt` — app state, SAF folder selection, scan/open jobs, error mapping, settings and progress.
- `data/PreferenceStore.kt` — SharedPreferences persistence for tree URI, book index JSON, page/video progress, favorites, settings.
- `data/BookRepository.kt` — `DocumentsContract` bulk queries, background extraction, PDF rendering, video preparation, cover and page caches; enforces safety limits.
- `data/Models.kt` — `Book`, `BookSession`, media-aware `PageSource`, `ReadingProgress`, `ReaderSettings`, `NaturalOrder`, `ReaderException`.
- `reader/ImageLoader.kt` — PNG-chunk APNG detection, AVIF via APNG4Android + libavif, other formats via `ImageDecoder`, sampled animation wrapper.
- `reader/ZoomImageView.kt` — native matrix zoom/pan in an `AndroidView`; unzoomed gestures pass through to Compose lists/pager.
- `ui/LibraryScreen.kt` — `ZViewerApp` entry, library grid, search/filter, continue-reading card.
- `reader/ReaderPaging.kt` — virtual loop positions mapped to real page numbers for LazyColumn / HorizontalPager.
- `reader/ZoomVideoView.kt` — Android gesture detection, zoom/pan, one-step directional paging, and a Media3 TextureView with aspect-fit layout.
- `ui/ReaderScreen.kt`, `ui/VideoReader.kt` — image reader and Media3 video playback with shared toolbar visibility, play/pause, and a seek slider. Pure video page changes retain the outgoing frame while waiting for the incoming player's first rendered frame and aspect-correct surface layout, then run a 240 ms slide with the outgoing player continuing and the incoming player paused. Mixed books use a horizontal Pager and one player per visible video page; only the settled page may play, offscreen players stay paused, and reactivating an ended player seeks back to the start and honors the preview setting. Each mixed player has a single owning view: ownership is transferred by detaching the previous view before binding the replacement, stale or transient duplicate views (looping can compose two virtual pages for one real page) cannot clear the live surface, and releasing a transient duplicate falls back to the still-settled view. Playback additionally requires the owning view's TextureView surface to be attached; without it the player pauses until the surface returns, so a player can no longer advance its clock while rendering nowhere. Keyed views stay in the same container throughout preparation, animation, and completion to preserve their TextureViews. The old transition player is released after a pure-video transition, while offscreen mixed-page players remain paused. Media preparation preserves view readiness so initial archive playback does not depend on another layout event. Video folders play directly from SAF URIs; video archive members use extracted files. Covers use MediaMetadataRetriever to sample the naturally sorted first video.
- `ui/SettingsScreen.kt`, `ui/Theme.kt` — Material 3 settings and theming.

Data flow: user picks a folder → SAF persistent read permission → background recursive scan → book index → cover generated on demand → book opened → image pages decoded or video members extracted → visible media played → page/video number and video position saved.

## Privacy and Security

- No `INTERNET`, external-storage read/write, or `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` permission; no accounts, ads, or telemetry.
- Only the user-granted directory is read; original comic files are never modified, moved, or deleted.
- Backups and device-to-device migration are disabled so URI grants do not migrate with app data.
- Archive members are written to app-generated sequential filenames; hidden files, macOS metadata (`.`, `__MACOSX`), symlinks, and unsupported entries are skipped. Member names are decoded as UTF-8 (`Archive.setCharset` overrides Android's C locale) so Chinese filenames do not raise ARCHIVE_WARN. An archive containing both images and videos opens as a mixed horizontal book. Any readable archive containing a PDF reports that PDFs must be extracted before reading, including mixed archives; parser failures retain the corrupt/archive error path.
- Safety limits: 20,000 pages per comic, 256 MB per image, 4 GB extracted per book, archive scan recursion depth 32.

## Build and Test

Requirements: JDK 17, Android SDK 36, network access for dependency download, Gradle 8.11.1 wrapper (bundled).

```sh
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android"
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug
./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest              # device format integration tests
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease                          # signed release build
```

- Unit tests: `app/src/test/java/dev/zolive/zviewer/data/NaturalOrderTest.kt` (natural ordering, hidden-file filtering, cache keys, image extensions).
- Paging tests: `app/src/test/java/dev/zolive/zviewer/reader/ReaderPagingTest.kt` (both loop boundaries, repeated cycles, single-page books, large page counts).
- Video and gesture regression tests: `VideoIntegrationTest.kt`, `ReaderInteractionTest.kt` in `app/src/androidTest/`; video samples are generated by `python3 tools/generate_video_fixtures.py` using FFmpeg.
- Instrumented tests: `app/src/androidTest/java/dev/zolive/zviewer/FormatIntegrationTest.kt` covering CBZ/ZIP, RAR4/CBR, RAR5, 7Z, PDF, image folders, HEIF/HEIC/AVIF, animated formats, corrupt/empty archives, path traversal, and a 4800×3200 APNG.
- Fixtures: generated by `tools/generate_fixtures.py`; `tools/ui_smoke.py` replays most manual UI flows.
- Release signing: key `.signing/zviewer-release.jks` (alias `zviewer`), passwords from `ZVIEWER_STORE_PASSWORD` / `ZVIEWER_KEY_PASSWORD`; output `app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`. Never commit `.signing/`.
- Distributed APKs live in `dist/` with SHA-256 checksums (e.g. `ZViewer-1.3.1-release.apk`).

## Key Dependencies

`androidx.compose:compose-bom:2025.05.01`, `androidx.activity:activity-compose:1.10.1`, `androidx.lifecycle:*:2.9.0`, `androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:1.6.1` and `:media3-ui:1.6.1`, Kotlin coroutines 1.10.2, `me.zhanghai.android.libarchive:library:1.1.6`, `com.github.penfeizhou.android.animation:apng:3.0.5` and `:avif:3.0.5`, `org.aomedia.avif.android:avif:1.3.0.841110fd`. Android framework gestures and thumbnail extraction use AOSP APIs (Apache 2.0).
